landing_title: Welcome to the Alttp & Quad Randomizer!
landing_intro: Create unique and surprising playthroughs of your favorite games.
landing_intro_alttpr: This randomizer shuffles all items in A Link to the Past and places them in random locations throughout the game world. The goal is to collect all necessary items to defeat Ganon and complete the game.
landing_intro_combo:
This randomizer mixes a combination of Super Metroid, A Link to the Past, Zelda 1 and Metroid 1

It will randomize all games items to any location in either of the games

The goal is to kill the end bosses in all selected games


Travel between the games can be done by using certain doors and entrances
